name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Louisville Distribution Center, KY

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (38.138117,-85.890606, ROOFTOP) is accurate - landed on the correct building. Confirmed as Coca-Cola Consolidated Louisville Distribution Center, 7100 Global Drive, Louisville KY 40258: a 305,000 sq ft sales/distribution center, a renovated former Circuit City warehouse on a ~25-acre site, ~210 employees. Street View shows the red 'Coca-Cola' script logo on the building's north facade.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single fenced truck entrance off Global Drive at the NW; the property is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence (visible in Street View). Truck drive runs south down the building's west side into the trailer yard. Gate hardware not directly resolvable in imagery - controlled entrance inferred from continuous fence + single drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No freestanding beside-the-lane guard booth visible. The white structure at the building's NW corner is an attached office/canopy entry, not a guard shack. guardShack=false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack -> remoteGs=true (kiosk/badge check-in implied).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~40 dock doors along the building's west face with trailers backed in; counted from z18-19 imagery, approximate (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers parked without tractors in the large fenced south trailer yard; substantial fleet of red Coca-Cola / Red Classic trailers and bobtail delivery trucks plus pallet storage.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank along one (west) building face - shipping and receiving share the same dock cluster. shipRcvSeparate=false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line curves along the NW/north edge of the property but runs parallel and does not enter the yard - no active rail spur into the site. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated fenced trailer-storage yard occupying the south half of the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southwest Louisville, dense Riverport/industrial-park fabric beside I-265 - Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach down the west drive into the south yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
